title: Simultaneous approximation to pairs of real numbers
summary: Let $B_{m}$ and $D_{n}$ be the denominators of the $m$th and $n$th convergent of the real numbers $α$ and $β$, respectively. We introduce an abnormal method in the theory of simultaneous Diophantine approximation to the pair $α,β$. Namely, the question of finding simultaneous approximation is turned into study of small solutions of a linear Diophantine equation $xB_{m} + yB_{m+1} = zD_{n} + vD_{n+1}$.
